---
title: "Literature Radar"
---

A compact archive of new PubMed papers from monitored journals.

```{r}
source("../R/site.R")
site <- load_literature_site_data("..")
```

## Journals

```{r, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="journal-grid">')
for (journal in site$journals) {
  latest <- journal$latest_report
  if (is.null(latest)) {
    update_line <- "No updates yet"
    summary_line <- "No AI summaries yet"
  } else {
    update_line <- paste0(
      "Last update: ", site_format_date(substr(latest$generated_at_utc, 1, 10)),
      " · ", latest$article_count, " papers"
    )
    summary_date <- if (nzchar(latest$latest_summary_at)) {
      site_format_date(substr(latest$latest_summary_at, 1, 10))
    } else {
      "Pending"
    }
    summary_line <- paste0("Latest AI summary: ", summary_date)
  }

  status <- if (isTRUE(journal$enabled)) {
    '<span class="journal-status monitoring">Monitoring</span>'
  } else {
    '<span class="journal-status inactive">Archived</span>'
  }
  slug <- site_slug(journal$id)
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<article class="journal-tile">',
      '<h3><a href="journals/%s.html">%s</a></h3>',
      '%s',
      '<p>%s</p>',
      '<p>%s</p>',
      '</article>'
    ),
    site_html_escape(slug),
    site_html_escape(journal$name),
    status,
    site_html_escape(update_line),
    site_html_escape(summary_line)
  ))
}
cat('</div>')
```
